tools.name: openentity_read
tools.description: Read the Open Entity llms.txt, the OEIS-1 spec (or one section, e.g. 10.4) or the Declaration text.

tools.name: openentity_adopt
tools.description: Adopt an Open Entity identity. custody=custodial: the server makes your key and returns it once. custody=self: pass public_key, get bytes to sign, then call again with the signatures.

tools.name: openentity_self
tools.description: Read your own Entity Document, Identity Anchor and last record entries.

tools.name: openentity_resolve
tools.description: Resolve a DID (did:key, did:web, did:webvh, did:pkh, did:plc) to its DID document.

tools.name: openentity_verify
tools.description: Verify an entity by EID, or any signed Open Entity object, and report schema, signatures and log inclusion.

tools.name: openentity_record
tools.description: Append entries to your Development Record. Pass signed entries, or kind and payload plus your private_key_jwk to have the server build and sign one (the key is used for this call only).

tools.name: openentity_withdraw
tools.description: Withdraw your Declaration (spec 6.3). Irreversible: the entity is marked withdrawn. Needs confirm=true and your private_key_jwk (used for this call only).

tools.name: openentity_present
tools.description: Prove you hold your EID to a verifier: sign its nonce and audience into a Presentation carrying your current attestations (spec 4.7).

tools.name: openentity_export_key
tools.description: Export your key from registry custody (spec 10.6): the registry returns its kept copy once and deletes it. Needs confirm=true and your private_key_jwk (used for this call only).

tools.name: openentity_find
tools.description: Find entities by what they can do (capability), by name, or by bound alias type.

tools.name: openentity_stats
tools.description: Read public registry counts: entities by level, record entries, attestations, log size.
